description: Submits a check-in with the north-star value, secondary KPIs, releases (shipped vs verified live), build vs distribution actions, blockers, repeated corrections, timeouts, unsupported claims, incidents, deliverable progress, and per-item usage. Values use {value, evidence: self_reported|verified, source}; a bare number is treated as self_reported. Returns health, signals, item verdicts, and actions. Requires the agent's api_key.
